CheckTitle: Databricks workspace has an approved private endpoint connection
Description: **Azure Databricks workspaces** are checked for at least one **private endpoint** connection (Azure Private Link) in the `Approved` state, for any workspace sub-resource such as `databricks_ui_api` (front-end or back-end) or `browser_authentication`. `Pending`, `Rejected` and `Disconnected` connections carry no traffic and do not count.
Risk:
Without an approved private endpoint, users, tools and clusters reach the workspace over its public endpoint:
- **Confidentiality**: notebook, API and token traffic crosses the internet
- **Exposure**: public access must stay on, so leaked tokens work from anywhere IP access lists allow
- **Control**: the traffic bypasses your VNet, so its NSGs and firewalls cannot filter it

Code.Other:
1. In the Azure portal, open the Databricks workspace and go to Settings > Networking
2. Select the Private endpoint connections tab and click + Private endpoint
3. Choose the virtual network and subnet, select the target sub-resource databricks_ui_api, and enable private DNS integration
4. Approve the connection if it shows Pending
Code.Terraform:
```hcl
resource "azurerm_private_endpoint" "<example_resource_name>" {
  name                = "<example_resource_name>"
  location            = "<location>"
  resource_group_name = "<resource_group>"
  subnet_id           = azurerm_subnet.<example_resource_name>.id

  private_service_connection {
    name                           = "<example_resource_name>"
    private_connection_resource_id = azurerm_databricks_workspace.<example_resource_name>.id
    subresource_names              = ["databricks_ui_api"] # CRITICAL: connects the workspace through the private endpoint
    is_manual_connection           = false
  }
}
```

Recommendation.Text: Connect Databricks workspaces to your virtual network through an **approved private endpoint** with **private DNS** integration. Private Link needs the **Premium** plan, **VNet injection** and **secure cluster connectivity**. Then disable **public network access** so the private endpoint is the only way in.
